$comment: Games (VTTER-72, docs/adr/0006-games.md; browse and unique names VTTER-76, docs/adr/0008-public-games-and-unique-names.md). A Game is the table people play an adventure from. Allowed values and limits for the API and app.
$listedComment: Suffix of the gsi1pk value for a listed public Game (`game#` + this). The shared sparse index gsi1 holds it only for a public Game whose GM opted into listing, so private Games can never appear.
$presenceComment: Who is at the table (VTTER-73, docs/adr/0012-presence.md). A heartbeat is sent while a Game page is open and visible. A player counts as online while their last beat is newer than onlineSeconds and named that Game. The beat is under half the window, so one missed beat does not flicker the dot.
